faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Department of Children Welfare and Special Services, Mayiladuthurai District (DCPU Mayiladuthurai) for filling up various contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DCPU Mayiladuthurai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the positions of Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant in the Mayiladuthurai District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled offline application form for DCPU Mayiladuthurai Recruitment 2026 is 12 October 2026. Make sure your application reaches on time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The applications for DCPU Mayiladuthurai Recruitment 2026 must be submitted through offline mode only. Candidates need to send the application via post or designated submission methods.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk post must have passed the X Standard or its equivalent with essential computer skills.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Office Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Office Assistant post must have passed the VIII Standard or its equivalent educational qualification from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for DCPU Mayiladuthurai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 42 years across the advertised posts. Please review the official notification for any applicable category-based age relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories. The application fee for all categories is Nil as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk will receive Rs. 20,000/- per month, while Office Assistants will receive Rs. 13,000/- per month respectively.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for DCPU Mayiladuthurai Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts primarily consists of Document Verification to validate candidate credentials and eligibility before final appointment.
